plan.title: Asset PR to Reverse Auction PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Commit the supported 30-minute event duration before publishing.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for the two required vendor bids.
Confirm publication reached a real event page.
Submit the first QA vendor's quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second QA vendor's quote of 90 through a distinct vendor portal session.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluating and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding has ended.
Verify the lower bid ranks ahead of the higher bid, establishing the L1 result.
Award the complete event to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Confirm one PO contains the awarded PR line and its requested quantity.
